question: What is the primary objective of most 'Fixed Income' portfolios?
options: High capital growth
Capital preservation and regular income
Speculating on penny stocks
Avoiding all forms of debt
answer: Capital preservation and regular income
hint: Debt आम तौर पर equity की तुलना में अधिक सुरक्षित होता है।
explanation: Fixed income securities cash flows (coupons) की एक predictable stream और maturity पर principal (मूलधन) की वापसी प्रदान करते हैं।

question: Which risk is the most significant for a long-term government bond portfolio?
options: Credit Risk
Interest Rate Risk
Liquidity Risk
Business Risk
answer: Interest Rate Risk
hint: G-Secs में कोई default risk नहीं होता है, लेकिन rates बदलने पर उनकी कीमतें बदलती हैं।
explanation: चूंकि government bonds sovereign होते हैं, इसलिए default risk शून्य होता है, लेकिन उनकी लंबी duration उन्हें interest rate के उतार-चढ़ाव के प्रति अत्यधिक संवेदनशील (sensitive) बनाती है।

question: What is 'Passive' Fixed Income management?
options: Trying to predict RBI policy moves
Buy-and-hold or indexing to match a benchmark
Trading bonds every day
Only buying high-yield junk bonds
answer: Buy-and-hold or indexing to match a benchmark
hint: Passive equity के समान, यह market returns से मेल खाने का प्रयास करता है।
explanation: Passive debt management, market timing से बचता है और coupon कमाने तथा index performance की बराबरी करने पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है।

question: Which active strategy involves moving between long-term and short-term bonds based on interest rate forecasts?
options: Immunization
Duration Management
Indexing
Buy and Hold
answer: Duration Management
hint: यदि rates गिरने की उम्मीद है, तो managers इसे बढ़ाते हैं।
explanation: जब interest rates गिरने की उम्मीद होती है, तो managers bond prices में होने वाली परिणामी वृद्धि (resulting rise) का लाभ उठाने के लिए portfolio की duration बढ़ा देते हैं।

question: A 'Bullet' strategy involves ________.
options: Investing in bonds with various maturities
Concentrating investments in bonds that mature around a single point in time
Buying only extremely high-risk bonds
Selling all bonds to buy equity
answer: Concentrating investments in bonds that mature around a single point in time
hint: Portfolio को एक maturity date पर 'लक्षित' (targeted) किया जाता है।
explanation: Bullet strategy का उपयोग तब किया जाता है जब किसी investor को किसी विशेष तिथि (particular date) पर भविष्य में विशिष्ट नकदी (specific future cash) की आवश्यकता होती है।

question: A 'Barbell' strategy involves ________.
options: Investing only in mid-term bonds
Investing in very short-term and very long-term bonds, with little in the middle
Buying bonds from only two companies
A balanced 50/50 mix of equity and debt
answer: Investing in very short-term and very long-term bonds, with little in the middle
hint: सिरों (ends) पर भारी, बीच में हल्का।
explanation: Short-term bonds, liquidity प्रदान करते हैं, जबकि long-term bonds उच्च yields और price sensitivity प्रदान करते हैं।

question: A 'Ladder' strategy involves ________.
options: Investing in only one bond
Investing in bonds with staggered maturities (e.g., 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 years)
Buying stocks to buy bonds
Climbing the credit rating chart
answer: Investing in bonds with staggered maturities (e.g., 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 years)
hint: जैसे ही एक bond mature होता है, पैसा ladder के अंतिम छोर पर reinvest (पुनर्निवेश) कर दिया जाता है।
explanation: Laddering reinvestment risk को कम करते हुए liquidity और yield के बीच संतुलन प्रदान करता है।

question: What is 'Portfolio Immunization'?
options: Protecting the portfolio from computer viruses
A strategy to match the duration of assets and liabilities to eliminate interest rate risk
Insuring the portfolio against default
Only buying tax-free bonds
answer: A strategy to match the duration of assets and liabilities to eliminate interest rate risk
hint: यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि price risk और reinvestment risk एक-दूसरे को बेअसर (cancel out) कर दें।
explanation: जब duration को time horizon से मिलाया जाता है, तो interest rates में बदलाव का bond के price और reinvestment income पर offsetting effect (संतुलनकारी प्रभाव) पड़ता है।

question: In a 'Falling' interest rate environment, an active manager should ________.
options: Decrease the portfolio duration
Increase the portfolio duration
Sell all bonds and keep cash
Only buy short-term T-bills
answer: Increase the portfolio duration
hint: Rates गिरने पर longer duration वाले bonds की कीमत में अधिक वृद्धि होती है।
explanation: Duration को बढ़ाकर, manager bond portfolio की capital appreciation (पूंजीगत वृद्धि) को अधिकतम करता है।

question: In a 'Rising' interest rate environment, an active manager should ________.
options: Increase the portfolio duration
Decrease the portfolio duration
Buy only 30-year government bonds
Ignore the market
answer: Decrease the portfolio duration
hint: Rates बढ़ने पर short-term bonds की कीमत कम गिरती है।
explanation: Duration कम करने से, interest rates के ऊपर जाने पर portfolio को भारी capital losses (पूंजीगत नुकसान) से बचाया जा सकता है।

question: What is 'Credit Spread' analysis?
options: Analyzing the distance between two banks
Monitoring the difference in yield between corporate bonds and government bonds
Calculating the manager's commission
Dividing the profit among clients
answer: Monitoring the difference in yield between corporate bonds and government bonds
hint: Wider spreads का मतलब आमतौर पर अर्थव्यवस्था में अधिक perceived risk (अनुमानित जोखिम) होता है।
explanation: Active managers यह अनुमान लगाने की कोशिश करते हैं कि क्या spreads 'tighten' (कम) होंगे (corporate bonds के लिए अच्छा) या 'widen' (चौड़े) होंगे (corporate bonds के लिए बुरा)।

question: What is 'Yield Curve' positioning?
options: Drawing a curve on a chart
Adjusting the portfolio based on the expected change in the shape of the yield curve
Only buying stocks that are growing
Investing in only 10-year bonds
answer: Adjusting the portfolio based on the expected change in the shape of the yield curve
hint: यह अनुमान लगाना कि curve, flatten (सपाट) होगा या steepen (तीखा) होगा।
explanation: Managers short-term और long-term rates के बीच संबंध (relationship) में होने वाले परिवर्तनों से लाभ कमाने के लिए विभिन्न maturities में positions लेते हैं।

question: Which of the following describes a 'Buy-and-Hold' debt strategy?
options: Trading daily to catch small price moves
Purchasing bonds and holding them until maturity to earn the coupon
Buying only bonds that are about to default
Holding cash until interest rates are 15%
answer: Purchasing bonds and holding them until maturity to earn the coupon
hint: शून्य turnover (Zero turnover) और कम लागत (low costs)।
explanation: यह passive strategy मध्यवर्ती मूल्य के उतार-चढ़ाव (intermediate price fluctuations) को अनदेखा करती है और interest से होने वाली स्थिर आय (steady income) पर ध्यान केंद्रित करती है।

question: What is 'Reinvestment Risk'?
options: The risk of losing the original investment
The risk that future coupons will be reinvested at lower interest rates
The risk of the manager resigning
The risk of paying too much brokerage
answer: The risk that future coupons will be reinvested at lower interest rates
hint: 'Ladder' और 'Buy-and-hold' strategies के लिए एक प्रमुख चिंता (concern)।
explanation: यदि interest rates गिरते हैं, तो bond से होने वाली आवधिक आय (periodic income) को बाजार में वापस लगाने पर कम कमाई होती है।

question: What is 'Convexity' in a bond portfolio?
options: The name of a bond issuer
A measure of the curvature of the relationship between bond prices and yields
The total number of bonds
The dividend yield of the bond
answer: A measure of the curvature of the relationship between bond prices and yields
hint: यह 'Duration' द्वारा की गई price prediction को सुधारने में मदद करता है।
explanation: Positive convexity निवेशकों के लिए अच्छी होती है क्योंकि rates गिरने पर कीमत में वृद्धि, rates बढ़ने पर कीमत में गिरावट की तुलना में अधिक होती है।

question: A 'Yield Pickup' strategy involves ________.
options: Selling high-yield bonds to buy low-yield ones
Moving from lower-yielding bonds to higher-yielding ones (often with higher risk)
Waiting for the RBI to increase rates
Only buying government bonds
answer: Moving from lower-yielding bonds to higher-yielding ones (often with higher risk)
hint: Portfolio की 'income' बढ़ाने का प्रयास करना।
explanation: इसमें अक्सर credit rating scale (उदा., AAA से AA) में नीचे जाना या longer maturities की ओर जाना शामिल होता है।

question: What is 'Total Return' strategy in fixed income?
options: Only caring about the coupon payments
Focusing on both interest income and capital gains from price changes
The return after paying all taxes
The amount of money the government returns
answer: Focusing on both interest income and capital gains from price changes
hint: Active management में आम है।
explanation: Total return managers, coupons इकट्ठा करने के अलावा interest rate movements से लाभ कमाने के लिए bonds में trade करते हैं।

question: Which type of bonds are most sensitive to interest rate changes?
options: Short-term bonds
Long-term bonds with low coupons
Bonds from large companies only
Floating rate bonds
answer: Long-term bonds with low coupons
hint: Long duration = High sensitivity (उच्च संवेदनशीलता)।
explanation: भविष्य में cash flows जितने दूर होंगे, discount rate (interest rate) के बदलने पर उनकी present value (वर्तमान मूल्य) में उतना ही अधिक बदलाव होगा।

question: What is 'Credit Migration' risk?
options: Bonds moving to a different country
The risk that a bond's credit rating will be downgraded
The risk of the manager moving to another firm
The risk of interest rates moving
answer: The risk that a bond's credit rating will be downgraded
hint: 'Investment Grade' से 'Junk' की ओर जाना।
explanation: Downgrade (रेटिंग में गिरावट) के कारण आमतौर पर bond price में भारी गिरावट आती है, भले ही issuer ने अभी तक default न किया हो।

question: What is 'Duration'?
options: The time until the next coupon
A measure of the weighted average time to receive all cash flows, representing interest rate sensitivity
The age of the bond
The total amount of interest paid
answer: A measure of the weighted average time to receive all cash flows, representing interest rate sensitivity
hint: वर्षों (years) में व्यक्त किया जाता है।
explanation: Duration एक निवेशक को मोटे तौर पर बताता है कि interest rates में 1% बदलाव के लिए bond की कीमत कितनी बदल जाएगी।

question: What is 'Modified Duration'?
options: A duration that has been changed by the manager
The Macaulay Duration adjusted for the current yield to reflect price sensitivity
Duration of a bond that has defaulted
A measure of credit risk
answer: The Macaulay Duration adjusted for the current yield to reflect price sensitivity
hint: Bond price में percentage change (प्रतिशत परिवर्तन) की गणना के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
explanation: Modified Duration = Macaulay Duration / (1 + y/k).

question: Which of the following describes 'Event Risk' in fixed income?
options: Risk of a party at the bank
The risk that a sudden event like a merger or takeover will hurt a bond issuer's credit quality
The risk of a daily market fluctuation
The risk of a bond maturing
answer: The risk that a sudden event like a merger or takeover will hurt a bond issuer's credit quality
hint: Corporate bonds के लिए विशिष्ट।
explanation: एक leveraged buyout अचानक कंपनी के कर्ज (debt) को बढ़ा सकता है, जिससे उसके मौजूदा bonds का downgrade हो सकता है।

question: What are 'G-Secs'?
options: Global Securities
Government Securities issued by the RBI on behalf of the Government
Gold Securities
Guaranteed Sector stocks
answer: Government Securities issued by the RBI on behalf of the Government
hint: भारतीय बाजार में 'Risk-Free' (जोखिम मुक्त) माना जाता है।
explanation: G-Secs देश में अन्य सभी interest rates के लिए benchmark हैं।

question: What is 'Sovereign Gold Bonds' (SGB) in a debt portfolio?
options: Bonds made of actual gold
A government debt instrument whose value is linked to the price of gold
A way to buy gold from a jewelry shop
Bonds issued only to NRIs
answer: A government debt instrument whose value is linked to the price of gold
hint: सोने की कीमत के लाभ (gold price gains) के अलावा fixed interest (निश्चित ब्याज) का भुगतान करता है।
explanation: SGBs को अक्सर diversification और महंगाई से सुरक्षा (inflation protection) प्रदान करने के लिए debt portfolios में शामिल किया जाता है।

question: A 'Floating Rate' bond helps protect the investor against ________.
options: Credit Risk
Rising Interest Rates
Falling Interest Rates
Taxation
answer: Rising Interest Rates
hint: बाजार दरें (market rates) बढ़ने पर coupon बढ़ता है।
explanation: चूंकि interest rate बाजार के साथ 'floats' (तैरता/बदलता) है, इसलिए fixed-rate bonds की तुलना में इन bonds की कीमत अपेक्षाकृत स्थिर (stable) रहती है।

question: What is 'Yield to Maturity' (YTM)?
options: The coupon rate
The total return anticipated on a bond if held until it matures
The current market price
The interest paid by a bank
answer: The total return anticipated on a bond if held until it matures
hint: यह bond का 'internal rate of return' (आंतरिक प्रतिफल दर) है।
explanation: YTM वर्तमान मूल्य (current price), सभी भविष्य के coupons और principal repayment (मूलधन पुनर्भुगतान) पर विचार करता है।

question: What is the 'Spread' in the corporate bond market?
options: The distance between two brokers
The difference between the yield of a corporate bond and a similar maturity government bond
The profit made by the manager
The tax rate
answer: The difference between the yield of a corporate bond and a similar maturity government bond
hint: Corporate credit के लिए 'Risk Premium' का एक माप।
explanation: एक high spread (उच्च प्रसार) यह दर्शाता है कि निवेशक corporate issuer को सरकार की तुलना में बहुत अधिक जोखिम भरा (riskier) मानते हैं।

question: What is a 'Zero Coupon Bond'?
options: A bond that pays no interest and is issued at a deep discount
A bond with 0% risk
A bond issued only by the RBI
A bond that has matured
answer: A bond that pays no interest and is issued at a deep discount
hint: लाभ (Profit) खरीद मूल्य (purchase price) और अंकित मूल्य (face value) के बीच के अंतर से आता है।
explanation: ये bonds (जैसे T-Bills) आवधिक ब्याज भुगतान (periodic interest payments) नहीं करते हैं।

question: What is 'Liquidity Risk' in debt markets?
options: The risk of the bond being liquid
The risk of not being able to sell a bond quickly at a fair price due to lack of buyers
The risk of a market crash
The risk of high inflation
answer: The risk of not being able to sell a bond quickly at a fair price due to lack of buyers
hint: कम रेटिंग वाले (lower-rated) corporate bonds में अधिक आम है।
explanation: G-Secs अत्यधिक liquid हैं, लेकिन कई corporate bonds में बहुत कम trade होता है, जिससे उन्हें जल्दी में बेचना मुश्किल हो जाता है।

question: What is 'Tax-Free' bonds?
options: Bonds given for free
Bonds where the interest income is exempt from income tax
Bonds with no transaction fees
Bonds issued by the income tax department
answer: Bonds where the interest income is exempt from income tax
hint: अक्सर NHAI या REC जैसी government-backed entities द्वारा जारी किया जाता है।
explanation: हालाँकि interest tax-free है, फिर भी उन्हें exchange पर बेचने से होने वाला capital gains (पूंजीगत लाभ) taxable (कर योग्य) होता है।

question: In fixed income, 'Laddering' helps to manage ________.
options: Credit risk only
Interest rate risk and reinvestment risk simultaneously
The manager's salary
Taxation only
answer: Interest rate risk and reinvestment risk simultaneously
hint: Staggered maturities (अचूक परिपक्वता) पुनर्निवेश (reinvestment) के लिए एक स्थिर नकदी प्रवाह (steady cash flow) प्रदान करती हैं।
explanation: यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि portfolio का केवल एक छोटा सा हिस्सा किसी भी एक समय में interest rate से प्रभावित हो।

question: What is 'Benchmark' in fixed income?
options: A desk at the exchange
An index (like the I-Sec Sovereign Bond Index) used to compare portfolio performance
The highest interest rate in history
A rule set by the RBI
answer: An index (like the I-Sec Sovereign Bond Index) used to compare portfolio performance
hint: Active manager के प्रदर्शन (performance) को मापने के लिए आवश्यक।
explanation: एक manager को अपनी active fees को सही ठहराने के लिए अपने benchmark से बेहतर प्रदर्शन (outperform) करना चाहिए।

question: What is 'Yield Curve' steepening?
options: When all interest rates go up
When the gap between long-term and short-term rates increases
When interest rates fall to zero
When the curve becomes a straight line
answer: When the gap between long-term and short-term rates increases
hint: आमतौर पर तब होता है जब निवेशकों को भविष्य में higher inflation/growth की उम्मीद होती है।
explanation: Steepening curve में, short-term bonds की तुलना में long-term bonds अपना मूल्य (value) अधिक खो देते हैं।

question: What is 'Yield Curve' flattening?
options: When the curve becomes a circle
When the gap between long-term and short-term rates decreases
When all bonds pay 0% interest
When the RBI closes
answer: When the gap between long-term and short-term rates decreases
hint: अक्सर धीमी होती अर्थव्यवस्था (slowing economy) या अपेक्षित दर कटौती (rate cuts) का संकेत देता है।
explanation: Flattening curve में, long-term bonds, short-term bonds की तुलना में बेहतर प्रदर्शन करते हैं।

question: What is 'Accrued Interest'?
options: Interest paid at the end of the year
The interest earned since the last coupon payment date
A penalty for late payment
Interest on a savings account
answer: The interest earned since the last coupon payment date
hint: जब coupon dates के बीच किसी bond का trade किया जाता है तो buyer इसका भुगतान seller को करता है।
explanation: यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि seller को वर्तमान interest period के दौरान उस समय के लिए मुआवजा (compensated) दिया जाए जब उसने bond को hold किया था।

question: The 'Clean Price' of a bond is ________.
options: The price after paying all taxes
The quoted market price excluding accrued interest
The price of a bond with no default risk
The face value
answer: The quoted market price excluding accrued interest
hint: आमतौर पर आप exchange screen पर यही देखते हैं।
explanation: Clean Price = Dirty Price - Accrued Interest.

question: The 'Dirty Price' (or All-in Price) is ________.
options: The price of a defaulting bond
The Clean Price + Accrued Interest
The price after brokerage fees
The price during a market crash
answer: The Clean Price + Accrued Interest
hint: नकदी की वास्तविक राशि (actual amount of cash) जिसका आदान-प्रदान होता है।
explanation: यह उस दिन तक अर्जित ब्याज (interest earned) सहित bond के कुल मूल्य (total value) को दर्शाता है।

question: Which of the following is a 'Money Market' instrument?
options: 30-year G-Sec
Commercial Paper (CP)
Equity share
Real estate fund
answer: Commercial Paper (CP)
hint: Corporations द्वारा जारी किया गया Short-term debt।
explanation: Money market instruments की परिपक्वता (maturity) एक वर्ष से कम होती है।

question: What is 'Certificate of Deposit' (CD)?
options: A certificate from a doctor
A negotiable money market instrument issued by banks
A type of equity share
A loan from the government
answer: A negotiable money market instrument issued by banks
hint: Short-term funds जुटाने के लिए बैंकों द्वारा उपयोग किया जाता है।
explanation: CDs बहुत liquid होते हैं और इन्हें low-risk debt instruments माना जाता है।

question: What is 'Default Risk'?
options: The risk of a stock price falling
The risk that the issuer will fail to pay interest or principal
The risk of an error in the system
The risk of the exchange closing
answer: The risk that the issuer will fail to pay interest or principal
hint: इसे Credit Risk के नाम से भी जाना जाता है।
explanation: Local currency में Government bonds को आमतौर पर शून्य (zero) default risk वाला माना जाता है।

question: Which credit rating is considered 'Investment Grade'?
options: BBB- and above
BB+ and below
Only AAA
D
answer: BBB- and above
hint: इसके नीचे, bonds को 'Junk' या 'Speculative' (सट्टा) कहा जाता है।
explanation: Institutional investors को अक्सर केवल investment-grade bonds खरीदने की ही अनुमति होती है।

question: What does a 'D' rating from a credit agency signify?
options: Double A rating
Default (the issuer has failed to pay)
Dividend paying
Discretionary
answer: Default (the issuer has failed to pay)
hint: सबसे कम संभव (lowest possible) रेटिंग।
explanation: 'D' रेटिंग का मतलब है कि bond अब अपने ऋण दायित्वों (debt obligations) को पूरा नहीं कर रहा है।

question: What is 'Call Risk'?
options: The risk of a broker calling the investor
The risk that the issuer will redeem the bond early when interest rates fall
The risk of the phone lines being down
The risk of not getting a dividend
answer: The risk that the issuer will redeem the bond early when interest rates fall
hint: Issuers कम दरों पर refinance करने के लिए महंगे debt को 'call' करके वापस मंगाते हैं।
explanation: यह निवेशक को 'reinvestment risk' के साथ छोड़ देता है क्योंकि उन्हें अपना पैसा lower-yielding bonds में लगाना पड़ता है।

question: What is 'Put Risk' for the issuer?
options: The risk that the investor will force the issuer to repay the bond early
The risk of buying a put option
The risk of the stock market falling
The risk of the government raising taxes
answer: The risk that the investor will force the issuer to repay the bond early
hint: Call risk के विपरीत (opposite)।
explanation: यदि market interest rates बढ़ते हैं और उन्हें कहीं और बेहतर return मिल सकता है तो निवेशक 'put' options का प्रयोग करते हैं।

question: What is 'Macaulay Duration'?
options: The total profit of the bond
The weighted average time to receive all cash flows from the bond
The name of the person who bought the bond
The market price
answer: The weighted average time to receive all cash flows from the bond
hint: जोखिम (risk) के 'समय' तत्व को मापता है।
explanation: इसे वर्षों (years) में मापा जाता है और यह price sensitivity की गणना का आधार है।

question: For a 'Zero Coupon Bond', the Macaulay Duration is equal to ________.
options: Zero
Half its maturity
Its time to maturity
Always 10 years
answer: Its time to maturity
hint: Duration को पहले खींचने के लिए कोई मध्यवर्ती (intermediate) cash flows (coupons) नहीं हैं।
explanation: चूंकि सारा cash केवल अंत में प्राप्त होता है, इसलिए इसे प्राप्त करने का औसत समय (average time) स्वयं maturity ही है।

question: Which of the following is a 'Hybrid' debt instrument?
options: Common stock
Convertible Debenture
T-Bill
Commercial Paper
answer: Convertible Debenture
hint: Equity में बदला जा सकता है।
explanation: यह debt के रूप में शुरू होता है लेकिन धारक (holder) को इसे बाद में कंपनी के शेयरों में बदलने (convert) का विकल्प देता है।

question: What is 'Securitization'?
options: Hiring security guards for the bank
Pooling individual loans (like home loans) and selling them as bonds to investors
Buying only safe stocks
A type of insurance
answer: Pooling individual loans (like home loans) and selling them as bonds to investors
hint: 'Pass-through Certificates' (PTCs) बनाता है।
explanation: Securitization बैंकों को अधिक ऋण (lend) देने के लिए पूंजी (capital) मुक्त करने में मदद करता है, जबकि निवेशकों को diversified debt exposure प्रदान करता है।

question: The 'Yield Curve' is usually ________.
options: Downward sloping
Upward sloping (Normal)
Flat
A straight vertical line
answer: Upward sloping (Normal)
hint: उच्च जोखिम/महंगाई (higher risk/inflation) के कारण Long-term rates आमतौर पर अधिक होती हैं।
explanation: एक स्वस्थ अर्थव्यवस्था (healthy economy) में, निवेशक अपने पैसे को लंबी अवधि के लिए लॉक करने के लिए अधिक ब्याज की मांग करते हैं।

question: What is 'Basis Point' (bps) in interest rates?
explanation: Interest rates में छोटे बदलावों पर हमेशा basis points (bps) में चर्चा की जाती है (उदा., 'RBI ने दरों में 25 bps की कटौती की')।
